messages:
alex: noticed a 12-18% CPU regression on host preparse after canary deploy v3.2.3. spike correlates with high small-request traffic. pprof shows host parse/tokenize eating more cycles. stack points to ingress::parse::tokenize -> grpc::decode -> http2::framer
maria: timeline? when did it start?
alex: started ~12:40 UTC, spike when canary promoted. can reproduce on bench with replay. quick pprof top:
```
(pprof) top
61.2%  parse_tokens
15.4%  kv_cache::lookup
9.0%   grpc::small_write_path
...
```
sam: grpc small_write path jumping up suggests writev coalesce lost. any change to kernel selector or batching in last deploy?
jen: we enabled eager-kernel-hint + new minibatch gating in the canary (PR #4521).
luis: that gating reduces batch depth for short sequences -> more per-request host CPU. may also increase KV churn.
alex: traces show syscall count per request up ~3x, and TCP profile is heavy on small frames (<512B). tcpdump summary: ~70% frames are small.
ops-bot: alert: host-cpu-90p triggered on pool-3 at 12:42 UTC :rotating_light:
maria: action: roll back eager-kernel-hint on canary, re-run replay. who can flip it?
jen: rolling back PR #4521 now.
sam: also seeing kvcache eviction spikes aligned with CPU. minibatch reduction probably hurts prefix KV hit rate. add kv_hit telemetry to replay harness.
luis: suggested safe fallback: if kv_hit_rate < 0.85 then force full-batch path and disable eager-kernel-hint for that route.
alex: replay with rollback results: cpu delta -14%, small writes down ~60%, avg latency stable. sharing bench logs in a sec.
maria: nice. follow-ups: (1) add perf-e2e for small-write distribution, (2) add regression test for kvcache hit-rate vs batching, (3) instrument kernel selection telemetery per-request.
sam: opening PERF-2234 for follow-ups and tasking infra to add kvcache probe to replay tool.
jen: note: we pushed eager-kernel-hint to speed up long sequences; need smarter gating. maybe use seq-length + kv_hit estimator to decide batch mode.
luis: agree. quick heuristic: if seq_len < 64 && kv_est_hit < 0.9 -> prefer full-batch; else keep eager hint.
alex: ack. I'll attach flame graphs and pprof snippets to PERF-2234. also adding a temporary rule in router to prefer batched path for traffic classes with high small-req ratio.
ops-bot: deploy bot: rollback completed for canary v3.2.3 -> v3.2.2 :white_check_mark:
maria: great work. can we add a canary perf gate that fails deploy if small-write fraction > 30% or cpu delta > 8% vs baseline?
jen: yes, adding to canary gating checklist.
sam: ack. thanks all. :thumbsup:
